stages.name: USER ACTION

modules.title: Welcome to Your Business Command Center
modules.subtitle: What this platform does for you

steps.title: Your Business Command Center
steps.content: This platform helps you run your insurance agency more efficiently. Instead of juggling spreadsheets, sticky notes, and memory, the system monitors your business and tells you exactly what needs attention.
bullets: Identify opportunities before they go cold
Prioritize work by business impact, not guesswork
Follow up consistently with every lead and client
Improve client relationships and retention
Increase referrals from existing clients and partners
Grow revenue with clear goals and forecasts
Stay organized with one centralized system

steps.title: Today's Top 5
steps.content: When you open the Command Center, the first thing you see is Today's Top 5. These are the highest-value actions available to you right now.
bullets: Each item is ranked by business impact and urgency
Items include leads to call, clients to review, and follow-ups due
The system considers value, timing, and relationship importance
Click any item to see details and take action

interaction.prompt: Click on a priority item below to see its details.

sample_priorities.reason: High-score lead, last contacted 6 days ago
Referral partner not contacted in 35 days

steps.title: Needs Attention
steps.content: Below the Top 5, you'll find a Needs Attention section. This shows items that require your awareness but may not be immediate action items.
bullets: Stale leads that are going cold
Clients with declining health scores
Revenue gaps that need attention
Overdue tasks and follow-ups

knowledge_check.question: What does Today's Top 5 show you?
options: A random list of tasks to do today
The highest-value actions available right now, ranked by impact
All the leads in your database
knowledge_check.explanation: Today's Top 5 ranks actions by business impact and urgency so you always know what matters most.

modules.title: Understanding Priorities
modules.subtitle: How the system decides what matters

steps.title: Meet a Priority Opportunity
steps.content: Let's look at a realistic example. [SAMPLE] John Smith is a lead in your system. Here's what the platform sees:
bullets: Value: $8,400 potential commission -- high impact
Urgency: Last contacted 6 days ago -- follow-up window closing
Probability: Lead score 92/100 -- very likely to convert
Timing: 42 days until Annual Enrollment Period -- planning window
Relationship: Previous conversations indicate strong interest
steps.explanation: The system weighs all five factors to rank this as a top priority. You don't need to remember any of this -- the system does it for you. You just need to act on the recommendation.

knowledge_check.question: What factors does the system use to prioritize opportunities?
options: Value, urgency, probability, relationship, and timing
The date the lead was first entered
knowledge_check.explanation: The system ranks opportunities using business factors like value, urgency, probability, relationship importance, and timing.

steps.title: Your #1 Recommended Action
steps.content: The Command Center includes a 'What Should I Do Next?' button. When you click it, the system analyzes all your opportunities and identifies the single most important action you can take right now.

sample_recommendation.reason: High-score lead (92/100) with $8,400 opportunity value. Last contacted 6 days ago. Medicare AEP is 42 days away -- this is the optimal time to follow up and schedule a consultation.
sample_recommendation.expected_impact: Scheduling a consultation could move this lead from 'hot' to 'closed', adding $8,400 to this month's revenue.
sample_recommendation.recommended_action: Call to schedule a Medicare plan review consultation

interaction.prompt: Click the 'What Should I Do Next?' button to see your recommendation.

steps.title: Execute Your First Action
steps.content: When you have a recommendation like 'Call [SAMPLE] John Smith', you can take action directly from the platform. Let's practice with a simulated call.

interaction.prompt: Click the CALL button to simulate calling John Smith.

steps.post_action_content: When you complete an action in the real system, several things happen automatically:
post_action_bullets: Your CRM updates with the contact record
Revenue forecasts adjust based on the outcome
Follow-up reminders are created if needed
The Command Center refreshes with new priorities

steps.title: What Happened on the Call?
steps.content: After completing an action, you record what happened. This is called the outcome. The system uses outcomes to improve future recommendations.

interaction.prompt: Select the outcome of your simulated call to John Smith.

outcomes.label: Connected
outcomes.description: Spoke with John, had a productive conversation

outcomes.label: Left Voicemail
outcomes.description: John didn't answer, left a message

outcomes.label: No Answer
outcomes.description: John didn't answer, no message left

outcomes.label: Appointment Scheduled
outcomes.description: Scheduled a consultation for next week

outcomes.label: Follow-Up Needed
outcomes.description: John asked to be contacted later

steps.post_outcome_content: By recording 'Connected', the system now knows that John is engaged and responsive. This improves his lead score and influences future recommendations. If you had selected 'No Answer', the system would suggest a different follow-up timing.
steps.explanation: Outcomes are the feedback loop that makes the platform smarter over time. The more outcomes you record, the better the recommendations become.

knowledge_check.question: Why should you record the outcome after completing an action?
options: It's required to use the platform
Outcomes improve future recommendations by telling the system what happened
It automatically sends emails to clients
It deletes the action from your list
knowledge_check.explanation: Outcomes are the feedback loop that makes the platform smarter. The more you record, the better future recommendations become.

steps.title: Creating a Follow-Up
steps.content: When a client asks you to call back later, you create a follow-up. Let's say [SAMPLE] Mary Johnson asked you to call her back on Friday about her Medicare plan options.

scenario_card.reason: Requested callback to discuss Medicare plan options

bullets: Set the date for when the follow-up is due
Add a reason so you remember why you're following up
Set priority based on urgency and value
The system automatically brings it back when it becomes due

interaction.prompt: Click 'Create Follow-Up' to schedule the callback.

steps.post_action_content: The follow-up is now scheduled. You can also snooze items for later or reschedule them if priorities change.

steps.title: Spotting an At-Risk Client
steps.content: The platform monitors your client relationships and alerts you when attention is needed. Here's a realistic scenario:
bullets: Client Health Score: 42/100 -- declining due to lack of contact
Client Lifetime Value: $18,500 -- this is a valuable relationship
Last Contact: 90 days ago -- well beyond the healthy 30-day window
Review Status: Annual review is overdue
steps.recommended_action: Schedule a client review call with Robert to discuss his current coverage and any life changes.
steps.explanation: The system surfaces this because losing a high-value client costs more than maintaining the relationship. A 30-minute call can protect $18,500 in lifetime value.

knowledge_check.question: What does a Client Health Score of 42/100 tell you?
options: The client has 42 contacts in the system
The client relationship is declining and needs attention soon
The client has been in the system for 42 days
knowledge_check.explanation: A declining health score means the relationship needs attention. The system alerts you before the client is lost.

steps.title: Waking Up a Dormant Referral Partner
steps.content: The platform tracks your referral sources and alerts you when a productive partner has gone quiet.
bullets: This partner has referred 7 clients this year -- a proven source
Last contact was 35 days ago -- the relationship is going cold
Potential opportunity: $12,400 in referral value available
Recommended action: Contact the partner to maintain the relationship
steps.explanation: Referral partners who go 30+ days without contact are likely to refer elsewhere. A quick check-in call can keep the pipeline flowing.

steps.title: Closing the Revenue Gap
steps.content: The platform tracks your revenue goal and forecasts what you're likely to earn. When there's a gap, it recommends actions to close it.
bullets: Monthly Goal: $35,000 -- what you want to earn this month
Forecast: $31,800 -- what the system predicts you'll earn
Gap: $3,200 -- the difference between goal and forecast
The platform recommends specific actions to close the gap
recommended_actions: Follow up with 3 hot leads worth $8,400 combined
Schedule 2 client reviews that could lead to referrals
Contact 1 dormant referral partner with $12,400 potential
steps.explanation: Every recommended action in the platform connects to your revenue goal. When you close the gap, your forecast improves.

steps.title: Content Awaiting Your Approval
steps.content: The platform generates marketing content for your review. Nothing is published without your approval.

scenario_card.compliance: PASS -- all content meets CMS guidelines

bullets: Review: Read the content and check it's accurate
Approve: Click approve to authorize publishing
Schedule: Choose when the content goes out
All content is checked for CMS Medicare Marketing compliance
steps.explanation: Marketing connects to lead generation. More content means more visibility, which means more leads entering your pipeline.

steps.title: Meaningful Changes in Your Business
steps.content: The What Changed? view shows you what's different since yesterday. Not everything that changes matters -- the system filters for meaningful business movement.

changes.explanation: Referral partners are more active -- 3 new referrals this week
New opportunities added to your pipeline
Fewer people opening emails -- may need content refresh
Just routine data entry -- not actionable

steps.explanation: The system distinguishes between information (nice to know) and actionable information (needs your attention). Focus on what's actionable.

knowledge_check.question: What's the difference between information and actionable information?
options: Information is nice to know; actionable information needs your attention
Actionable information is only about revenue
knowledge_check.explanation: The system filters for meaningful changes that need your attention, so you don't waste time on routine data updates.

steps.title: Your Business Health Score
steps.content: The Scorecard gives you a single number that represents the overall health of your business. It's like a fitness tracker for your agency.
bullets: Revenue Score: Are you hitting your revenue goals?
Lead Score: Are you managing leads effectively?
Client Score: Are your client relationships healthy?
Referral Score: Are you growing through referrals?
Marketing Score: Is your marketing active and compliant?
Execution Score: Are you completing recommended actions?
steps.explanation: The Scorecard identifies your strengths, weaknesses, and biggest opportunities. Focus on improving your weakest category for the biggest business impact.

knowledge_check.question: What does the Business Health Score represent?
options: The number of clients in your system
The overall health of your business across all key areas
knowledge_check.explanation: The Business Health Score combines all categories into one number so you can see at a glance how your business is doing.

steps.title: The Weekly Business Brief
steps.content: Each week, the Scorecard generates a Weekly Business Brief. This is your summary of what happened and what to focus on next.

scenario_card.biggest_win: Marketing is your strongest area at 92/100
scenario_card.biggest_concern: Execution at 75/100 -- you're not completing all recommended actions
scenario_card.biggest_opportunity: Raising Execution by 25 pts would improve your overall score by 2.5 pts
weekly_focus: Review and approve 3 marketing content pieces

steps.explanation: Use the Weekly Brief every Friday to review your week, celebrate wins, address concerns, and plan your focus for next week.

leads.title: Leads & Follow-Ups
leads.help: This view shows your leads ranked by priority. Hot leads should be contacted first. Follow-ups are scheduled callbacks that are due. Record outcomes after every contact to improve recommendations.

lead-scoring.title: Lead Priorities
lead-scoring.help: Leads are ranked by their likelihood to convert and potential value. Focus on leads with scores above 80 first. The system considers timing, value, and engagement.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.help: Your revenue pipeline shows opportunities at each stage. Focus on moving opportunities from 'prospecting' to 'closed'. The close rate tells you how effectively you're converting.

actions.title: Action Center
actions.help: All your recommended actions in one place. Execute actions by clicking the action buttons. After completing, record the outcome. Snooze items you can't get to today. Dismiss items that are no longer relevant.

nurture.title: Client Health
nurture.help: Client Health Scores show the strength of each client relationship. Scores below 50 need attention. Contact at-risk clients before they leave. Reviews should be completed annually.

clv-intel.title: Client Lifetime Value
clv-intel.help: CLV shows the total value of each client relationship over time. Focus on retaining high-CLV clients. A 30-minute call can protect thousands in lifetime value.

referral-intel.title: Referral Opportunities
referral-intel.help: This view shows referral sources ranked by potential. Contact dormant partners to reactivate the referral pipeline. The system identifies which partners are most likely to refer again.

referrals.title: Referral Sources
referrals.help: Track and manage your referral sources. Contact partners regularly to maintain relationships. The system alerts you when a productive partner goes quiet.

community.title: Community Outreach
community.help: Community events and workshops drive brand awareness and lead generation. Schedule workshops, track attendance, and follow up with attendees.

marketing.title: Content & Campaigns
marketing.help: Marketing content is generated for your review. Nothing is published without your approval. Review, approve, and schedule content. All content is checked for CMS compliance.

revenue-forecast.title: Revenue & Forecast
revenue-forecast.help: Your revenue goal vs. your forecast. When there's a gap, the system recommends actions to close it. Focus on high-value leads and referral opportunities to close the gap.

executive.title: Strategic Analysis
executive.help: Executive-level analysis of your business. Daily briefings, priority lists, and strategic recommendations. Use this for high-level planning and decision-making.

what-changed.title: What Changed?
what-changed.help: Shows meaningful business changes since yesterday. The system filters out routine updates and focuses on actionable changes. Review this daily to stay on top of your business.

crm.title: CRM Management
crm.help: Manage your contact database. Keep records clean and up-to-date. The system flags duplicates and data quality issues for your attention.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.help: All marketing content is checked for CMS Medicare Marketing Guidelines compliance. Never publish content that hasn't passed compliance review.

system-audit.title: System Audit
system-audit.help: Full system health check. Shows the status of all 12 agents and their endpoints. Use this to verify the system is running correctly.

training.title: Training Mode
training.help: Learn how to use the platform through guided modules and simulations. Work through each module in order. Knowledge checks ensure you understand before advancing. Ask the Training Coach if you have questions.

normalized.message: Complete all training modules to earn your certificate.
